Ginesys KB Revamp

Feedback & Gaps Identified

We held feedback sessions with our Ginesys teams and compiled the problems they raised in one place: 26 problems in four categories, each showing who raised it. The research and proposed solution in the other tabs build on these.

Platform problemFixing it needs one decision about the KB itself (hosting, access, templates, language) that applies to many pages.
ProcessA routine is missing (templates, release notes, customer notifications, archiving).
Incomplete or wrong contentPages exist but are partial, incorrect or old. Fixed by editing pages.
No contentNothing exists for this topic yet.
